passages.title: Talk 1
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 1 through 3 refer to the following announcement.
W: Attention, passengers on Flight 218 to Denver. Due to a mechanical check, boarding has been delayed by forty-five minutes. The new boarding time is four fifteen at Gate B12. Passengers who wish to change their connecting flights may speak to an agent at the service desk near Gate B10. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

passages.title: Talk 2
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 4 through 6 refer to the following telephone message.
M: Hello, this is Carlos from Brightway Office Supplies. I'm calling about your order of two hundred notebooks. Unfortunately, the blue ones are out of stock until next Wednesday. We can ship the black notebooks today, or we can wait and send everything together next week with free delivery. Please call me back at extension 214 before noon so that I can update your order.

questions.stem: Where is the announcement most likely being made?

fr.rule: Lieu : « Flight 218 », « boarding », « Gate B12 » indiquent un aéroport.
why_wrong: C : il s'agit d'un vol, pas d'un bus.

en.rule: Place: 'Flight 218', 'boarding', 'Gate B12' point to an airport.
why_wrong: C: it is a flight, not a bus.

questions.stem: What is the new boarding time?

fr.rule: Détail chiffré : « The new boarding time is four fifteen ».
why_wrong: A : 4:45 correspond à un autre calcul, pas à l'annonce.

en.rule: Numerical detail: 'The new boarding time is four fifteen'.
why_wrong: A: 4:45 is not what the announcement says.
C: 4:00 is not the time given.

questions.stem: What can passengers do at the service desk?
choices: Claim a refund for a meal

fr.rule: Détail : les passagers peuvent « change their connecting flights » au comptoir.
why_wrong: B : aucun remboursement de repas n'est cité.
D : l'enregistrement des bagages n'est pas mentionné.

en.rule: Detail: passengers may 'change their connecting flights' at the desk.
why_wrong: B: no meal refund is mentioned.
D: luggage check-in is not mentioned.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the message?
choices: To report a problem with an order

fr.rule: Objet du message : les cahiers bleus sont en rupture de stock, donc un problème de commande.
why_wrong: A : aucune date de livraison n'est confirmée, des options sont proposées.
C : il n'y a pas de promotion.
fr.example: The message reports a stock problem.

en.rule: Purpose: the blue notebooks are out of stock, so there is an order problem.
why_wrong: A: no delivery date is confirmed; options are offered.
en.example: The message reports a stock problem.

questions.stem: What will happen if the customer waits until next week?
choices: The order will be shipped with free delivery.

fr.rule: Détail : si le client attend, tout sera envoyé ensemble « with free delivery ».
why_wrong: C : aucune hausse de prix n'est annoncée.

en.rule: Detail: if the customer waits, everything ships together 'with free delivery'.
why_wrong: C: no price increase is announced.

questions.stem: What does the speaker ask the listener to do before noon?

fr.rule: Demande : « Please call me back at extension 214 before noon ».
why_wrong: A : aucun nouveau formulaire n'est demandé.
C : aucun retrait de colis n'est évoqué.
fr.example: The listener must call back before noon.

en.rule: Request: 'Please call me back at extension 214 before noon'.
why_wrong: A: no new form is requested.
en.example: The listener must call back before noon.
